Reviewed on 2026-10-15: npm view reports latest sprintf-js 1.1.3; npm audit reports <=1.1.3 affected with no patched release. Installed 1.0.3 is consumed only by argparse 1.0.10 under @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config 1.1.0 -> js-yaml 3.15.2, reached from babel-plugin-istanbul 6.1.1/Jest 29 tooling. Inspected argparse sprintf() calls: HelpFormatter accepts developer-controlled usage/text/help format templates; the js-yaml CLI supplies fixed templates, and CLI arguments/YAML values do not become precision specifiers. The actual Istanbul path calls js-yaml.load(), whose library entry does not load argparse or sprintf-js. New tests pin this chain and expiry, block app/config/script imports, and load YAML containing %.1000000f with argparse/sprintf loading blocked and a positive control. Fresh Android/iOS/web export source maps exclude sprintf-js and argparse. Temporary risk acceptance for this reviewed path; arbitrary argparse help templates are not covered. Reassess upstream patches, the Jest/Expo-compatible removal path, consumer/API changes, format-string inputs, and exported bundles before 2026-10-29; do not automatically extend or upgrade to Jest 30 without compatibility review.
